sessions.coaching_review: Master Coach Review: In debate formats like Parliamentary Debate, controlling the metric of evaluation is critical. When defending Affirmative on "Junk food is bad health", always define the decision criterion in your opening turn. By framing whether the debate hinges on pragmatic solvency or rights-based ethics, you force The Contrarian to debate on your chosen terrain rather than allowing them to shift the burden of proof. Continue refining your evidentiary citations.

transcript.speaker: AI Opponent (The Contrarian)
transcript.text: Labeling junk food as categorically harmful ignores the fundamental nutritional principle that dose dictates toxicity. In contexts of severe caloric deficit or high-energy expenditure, high-calorie, shelf-stable foods provide essential energy and accessibility that prevent acute undernourishment. Furthermore, moderate consumption within an otherwise balanced diet shows no statistically significant adverse health outcomes, making the blanket categorization of these foods as inherently destructive medically inaccurate.
